subject: Application received: Backend Engineer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying to the Backend Engineer position at Zentech. We have received your application and resume. Our engineering team will review your qualifications and reach out within 5-7 business days if your profile matches our requirements.

Best regards,
Talent Acquisition Team
Zentech Solutions Pvt Ltd

subject: Offer letter - pay Rs 4,999 training fee
body:
Dear Candidate,

You have been selected for the position of Systems Associate at Infosys Technologies without examination based on your profile. To secure your corporate training batch slot and company laptop, please pay the mandatory refundable training fee of Rs 4,999 via UPI to info.batch@upi.

Also send high-resolution photos of your original Aadhaar card and PAN card to confirm your background verification.

Regards,
Infosys Recruitment Cell

subject: Interview invite: Round 1 on 27 Oct
body:
Hello Alex,

We were impressed by your background and would love to invite you to Round 1 (Technical & Architecture Discussion) for the Frontend Engineer role at Finly.

We have scheduled your 45-minute Google Meet interview for 2026-10-27 at 3:00 PM IST. Please confirm if this time works for you.

Looking forward to speaking,
Finly Recruiting Team

subject: Thank you for applying - Fullstack Developer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your interest in joining Swiggy as a Fullstack Developer. We have received your application successfully. Our hiring managers are currently evaluating applications. If your experience aligns with our needs, we will reach out with the next steps.

Warm regards,
Swiggy Careers Team

subject: Application Received: Senior Frontend Engineer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for submitting your application for the Senior Frontend Engineer position at Razorpay! We build financial infrastructure for the internet and are excited to review your submission. We will get back to you shortly.

Cheers,
Razorpay Talent Team

subject: Your application to Postman: Developer Relations Engineer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying to the Developer Relations Engineer opening at Postman! Our team is reviewing applications on a rolling basis. You can track your application status via our Postman careers portal.

Best,
Postman Recruitment Team

subject: Application Acknowledged: iOS Engineer
body:
Hello Alex,

Your application for iOS Engineer at CRED has reached our inbox. We appreciate the time you took to share your journey with us. Our hiring team will review your background and get in touch if there is a strong match.

Team CRED

subject: Application Submitted: SDE 1 (Platform Team)
body:
Dear Alex,

We have received your application for SDE 1 (Platform Team) at Flipkart Internet Pvt Ltd. Your application reference number is FK-2026-89104. Our recruiting team will contact you if your profile is shortlisted for online assessments.

Best wishes,
Flipkart Talent Acquisition

subject: Interview Invitation: Systems & Infrastructure Engineer - Round 1
body:
Hi Alex,

We evaluated your code submission and would like to invite you for a 60-minute technical interview for the Systems & Infrastructure Engineer role at Zerodha. The interview is set for 2026-10-28 at 11:00 AM IST on Google Meet.

Please confirm your availability.

Regards,
Zerodha Tech Hiring

subject: Interview Invitation: Technical Round with Tech Lead
body:
Hi Alex,

Following up on your Backend Engineer application submitted on Oct 10th, our engineering manager was very pleased with your profile. We would like to schedule your Technical Round on 2026-10-25 at 2:00 PM IST via Google Meet.

Please reply to confirm this slot.

Best regards,
Talent Acquisition Team
Zentech Solutions Pvt Ltd

subject: Update on your application for Software Engineer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with our team about the Software Engineer role at Atlassian. While we were impressed with your technical depth and problem-solving skills, we have decided to move forward with candidates whose experience more closely matches our immediate architecture needs.

We wish you all the best in your job search and hope to stay in touch for future openings.

Sincerely,
Atlassian Talent Team

subject: Notion Application Status: Product Designer
body:
Hello Alex,

Thank you for giving Notion the opportunity to consider your background for the Product Designer position. After careful review of your portfolio, we will not be moving forward with your candidacy at this time. We truly appreciate the effort you put into your application.

Best,
The Notion Recruiting Team

subject: Uber Interview Update: Data Platform Engineer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your time during our technical screening for the Data Platform Engineer position. While the committee found your background commendable, we are prioritizing candidates with deeper distributed streaming experience for this specific role.

We will keep your resume on file for future opportunities.

Kind regards,
Uber Global Talent Acquisition

subject: Offer of Employment: Staff Infrastructure Engineer at Stripe
body:
Hi Alex,

On behalf of Stripe Inc, I am thrilled to extend a formal offer of employment for the position of Staff Infrastructure Engineer. Your annual base salary will be INR 58,00,000 along with comprehensive equity grants and health benefits.

Please find your formal offer letter attached, and log into our official candidate portal at stripe.com/careers/portal to review the terms. Formal background check will be initiated via Checkr once you sign.

Congratulations, and welcome to Stripe!

Warm regards,
Sarah Jenkins
Global Talent Partner, Stripe

subject: Formal Job Offer: Senior Backend Lead - Pine Labs
body:
Dear Alex,

We are delighted to offer you the position of Senior Backend Lead at Pine Labs Pvt Ltd. Your total compensation package is detailed in the annexed appointment agreement on our secure HR portal.

Please review and e-sign the document within 10 days. We look forward to welcoming you to the fintech team!

Best regards,
Head of HR, Pine Labs

subject: Provisional Selection Offer: Junior Software Trainee - Refundable Security & Training Fee
body:
Dear Candidate,

Congratulations! Based on your resume uploaded on online job boards, you have been selected for direct joining as Junior Software Trainee at Tech Mahindra. Package offered: Rs 6.8 LPA.

To confirm your seat in the corporate induction batch starting Monday, deposit Rs 6,500 refundable security and documentation charge to UPI ID tm-onboard@icici today before 5:00 PM. Failure to pay will cancel your appointment.

Corporate HR Desk,
Tech Mahindra Careers Portal

subject: Immediate Employment: Submit Aadhaar Card and PAN Card for Payroll Verification
body:
Dear Applicant,

We are pleased to select you for the Remote Operations Analyst role at Rs 75,000 monthly stipend. No prior interview needed.

For immediate issuance of your offer letter and payroll setup, you must reply immediately to this email attaching high-resolution scanned copies of your Aadhaar Card (both sides), PAN Card, and your internet banking cancelled cheque. Documents must be submitted within 24 hours.

Yours sincerely,
Apex Global Hiring

subject: Urgent Interview Invitation: Remote Cloud Associate (Chat on Telegram)
body:
Hello Alex,

Your profile has been shortlisted for the Remote Cloud Associate role ($45/hr). Our VP of Engineering Mr. Andrew is conducting preliminary text interviews exclusively over Telegram today.

Please install Telegram Messenger immediately and text our lead recruiter @CloudScale_HR_Interviews with interview invitation code #CS-8921 to begin your chat assessment right now.

Regards,
CloudScale Talent Outreach

subject: TCS Expedited Joining Letter - Gate Pass & Verification Charge
body:
Dear Candidate,

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) announces your provisional selection as Associate Software Engineer. Please review your appointment terms.

You are instructed to deposit Rs 3,500 towards mandatory security badge and gate pass issuance at the TCS campus. The payment should be made to our treasury account via IMPS/UPI. Your joining letter will be released immediately upon receipt.

TCS NextStep Recruitment Directorate
